criteria.criterion: One decidable goal with the scope boundaries stated
Every request item maps to a unit and every unit traces back
Every unit carries a checkable MUST/SHOULD criterion taken from the request
Every MUST criterion names a check that is runnable as written
One writer per surface and units ordered by dependency
Unsafe or unresolvable items name the HALT path and the operator question

coverage.basis: all 7 sections of the spec and all 6 unit rows were read; the 4 tables were parsed row by row

findings.evidence: U2's verification passes one verdict file, but the unit produces two rounds; the round ordering the gate must read is undefined
U2 verifies with a test module that U2 itself creates, so 'the check exists today' is false as written and the plan-review check would reject every self-referential plan
U3 requires a loop statement in every OMP foreground module, but the modules compose one pinned policy with a 700-token cap; duplication is the failure mode
U4 and U5 change tool, test, and record counts, but no unit acceptance names the measured-state refresh that the gate enforces
the effective date is stated in the spec header but not as the default value the ordering gate applies, so a consumer cannot tell what grandfathering it gets

claims.claim: The spec is decidable and every request item has a unit
The plan is not ready for Implement: two high findings are open

notes: Round 0 of the plan review, run against the six WL-15 checks on the spec alone.
